versions.name: Camp Sandsland
versions.summary: A primitive Narragansett Council camping area on Block Island in New Shoreham, Rhode Island, with a handful of tent sites on wooded acreage reached by ferry and often used as a base camp for island activities.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Narragansett Council camps listing (narragansettbsa.org), which lists Camp Sandsland - Block Island as one of its six current weekend-camping properties. The source's rarrtl-sandsland property URL is dead; the current camp page is used instead. Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate; the street address has no house number to geocode exactly); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council camps page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a primitive weekend-camping property; features unsurveyed.
